shots.visual: A close-up of a hand trembling violently, ink from a brush dripping onto a silk scroll.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 曹丕竟然敗了……這不可能！

shots.visual: He paces frantically on the deck, his face pale and drenched in cold sweat.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 劉備下一個目標，定是東吳！

shots.visual: He stares at the map of the Yangtze River, his eyes wide with terror.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 孤不能坐以待斃，快傳使者！

shots.visual: He points toward the direction of the Shu kingdom with a shaky finger.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 把孫尚香送回去，立刻送走！

shots.visual: He begins writing a letter with desperate speed, ink splashing on his robe.

lines.speaker: sun_quan
lines.text: 再割讓三郡，換劉備罷兵！

shots.visual: A messenger from Wu kneels before the throne in the center of the military tent.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 三日後，東吳使者抵達前線。

shots.visual: The messenger holds a golden box and a scroll high above his head.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 吳主願與大漢永結同盟。

shots.visual: He fans himself slowly, a knowing and slightly mocking smile on his lips.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 看來孫權是真的怕了。

shots.visual: He sits motionless, his gaze cold and sharp as a blade.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孫權的誠意，都在這了？

shots.visual: The messenger looks up, sweating profusely under the pressure.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 金帛萬兩，並奉還舍妹尚香。

shots.visual: The messenger adds the final, desperate offer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 另割讓荊州三郡，請皇叔息怒。

shots.visual: He stands up slowly, walking toward the messenger with heavy steps.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 三郡之地，就想買他的命？

shots.visual: The messenger trembles, his voice cracking with fear.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 這已是東吳最大的退讓！

shots.visual: He takes the silk scroll, his expression unreadable and icy.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 退讓？

shots.visual: He suddenly grips the scroll and rips it in half with great force.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 孤不需要他的施捨！

shots.visual: Tattered pieces of the peace treaty flutter to the ground like snow.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公，此刻開戰消耗甚巨。

shots.visual: He turns back to the tactical map, pointing at the Wu territory.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 東吳欠下的債，該還了。

shots.visual: The messenger is paralyzed, staring at the torn scroll on the floor.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 您難道要與東吳不死不休？

shots.visual: An extreme close-up of his eyes, burning with an unyielding flame of ambition.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 和談？我要的是天下！

shots.visual: He places his hand firmly on the hilt of his sword, ready for war.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳令下去，兵發建業！

shots.visual: The entire tent goes silent as the declaration of war resonates. Fade to black.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 三國版圖，即將易主！
